title: lasianthera macrocarpa
intro: Lasianthera macrocarpa, commonly known as African boxwood, is a plant species within the family Rubiaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Lasianthera macrocarpa include analgesic, anti-spasmodic, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its use in treating pain and muscle spasms. Research has identified bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids in the plant, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
